slides.headline: Catch small slips before you rely on results
slides.body: A built-in setting called the review option gives each run a second pass before it finishes, so mistakes are easier to spot.
slides.name: Review option
slides.tryIt: Switch on the review option in settings; each run gets a second pass.

slides.headline: Keep long chats quick by clearing old messages
slides.body: A built-in command called trim shortens a long conversation to its latest messages, so replies stop slowing down.
slides.name: /trim
slides.tryIt: Type `/trim 20` and press Enter to keep the last 20 messages.

slides.headline: Pick up a crashed run where it stopped
slides.body: A built-in option called snapshot saves the state of a run while it works, so a crash loses nothing.
slides.name: --snapshot
slides.tryIt: Pass `--snapshot` when you start a run, then `--resume` to continue.
